dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, are there any bedrooms downstairs?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ər ðɛr ˈɛni ˈbɛdruːmz ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, there aren't. The bedrooms are upstairs.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ðɛr ˈɑːrnt. ðə ˈbɛdruːmz ər ˌʌpˈstɛrz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, there is. But it's very small. There's only a toilet.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðɛr ˈɪz. bʌt ɪts ˈvɛri ˈsmɔːl. ðɛrz ˈoʊnli ə ˈtɔɪlət.
